This allows developers to easily integrate with our system and retrieve the necessary data to fulfill their specific needs. The communication between the API client and server is achieved through the exchange of data in JSON format, which is a lightweight and widely used data interchange format. Before you start You will need: LinearB API Token - In order to use LinearB REST API an API token must be pass as a parameter (key:”x-api-key”) in the request header For more information on how to generate an API token visit here Rate Limits Tracking of call volume operates on a minute-based system.
